changes_made: SharedService.recordMacro(): replaced window.btoa(pwdField['value']) with GXUtils.pwdMask ('*') — password value is NOT stored in the macro; only a placeholder marker is written
SharedService.recordMacro(): scoped document.querySelectorAll to app-root container instead of entire document — prevents capturing password inputs from browser extensions or unrelated DOM elements
MacroComponent.decryptBeforePlay(): replaced window.atob(fieldElement.value) decode with a no-op placeholder comment — macro playback now recognizes the mask marker without decoding
MacroComponent.decryptBeforePlay(): added element?.fields null guard — prevents TypeError crash if element.fields is undefined
MacroComponent.ngOnInit(): replaced fragile substr(1, length-2) with JSON.parse() for userName
MacroComponent basePath: removed hardcoded HTTP localhost dead-code field (VULN-016)

files_modified.changes: recordMacro(): scoped querySelectorAll to app-root container; replaced window.btoa with GXUtils.pwdMask placeholder.
decryptBeforePlay(): added element?.fields null guard, removed window.atob() decode. ngOnInit(): replaced substr with JSON.parse. Removed basePath dead-code field.

defense_in_depth.primary_control: Password values are never stored in macro files — only GXUtils.pwdMask ('*') placeholder is written. Even with full ApplinX server access, macro JSON files contain no recoverable credentials.
secondary_controls: DOM query scoped to app-root prevents capturing unrelated password fields from browser overlays
Null guard in decryptBeforePlay() prevents TypeError crash during macro playback
VULN-016 fix: hardcoded HTTP basePath removed — eliminates future risk of macro API calls over HTTP
response: Macros recorded before this fix that contain base64 passwords on the ApplinX server should be deleted and re-recorded
UI should prompt user for password at macro playback time when the mask placeholder is encountered
